## Behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.
Identify any change to filtering, authorization, persistent state or defaults.

## Validation

Record the commands, platform and results. Distinguish fixtures/native tests,
package verification and actual deployment evidence; explain relevant skips.

## Deployment and recovery

For service-impacting changes, identify compatibility, current-state backup,
activation and forward-recovery requirements. State whether this PR deploys
anything. Keep credentials, mail content, database/model files and private logs
out of the PR.
